entities.name: Christopher T. Hill
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Christopher T. Hill is a theoretical physicist, formerly of the Fermi National Accelerator Laboratory, who did undergraduate work in physics at M.I.T., and graduate work at Caltech. His work mainly focuses on new physics that can be probed in laboratory experiments or cosmology.
